The '''Sonn Vilmari system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Colundra sector/Legends|Colundra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sonn Vilmari]].
